editorial:
Imagine being forced to carry a dangerous drug inside your body, only to have it leak and unlock powers you never knew existed. That is the wild ride you are in for with Lucy. Scarlett Johansson plays a woman who starts out scared and ordinary, then quickly becomes something far beyond human. The story moves fast, jumping from city streets to wild action scenes, and it never really slows down. You will feel the tension right from the start, and the movie keeps throwing bigger and stranger moments at you.

The action is slick and fun, and Johansson carries the whole thing with a cool, calm energy that makes her character feel powerful. The pacing is quick, sometimes too quick, and the science behind it is pretty silly if you think too hard. Still, if you want a popcorn movie that is loud, flashy, and easy to enjoy, this is a great pick. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture and sound.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Lucy reaches one hundred percent of her brain power and transforms into a glowing, computer-like being. She travels through time and space, touching the first human and the universe itself. She leaves behind a flash drive containing all her knowledge for Professor Norman. The twist is that Lucy is no longer human at all, just pure information, and she tells you she is everywhere.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves action-packed sci-fi with a strong lead and wild ideas.
